prodinfo.prodname: X-Author Contracts for Cloud on Salesforce Summer 2019 User Guide

conbody.p: A template is the blueprint using which an agreement is generated and clauses or supporting documents are created. Template outlines the content and the format of an agreement, clause, and a supporting document. After you create a new template or make changes to an existing template, you can check-in the template to update its contents in the CRM.
